notes.title: ROSE - New Update Released!
notes.content:
🌹 ROSE Update Released!

Our latest update brings several important fixes and improvements:

 🛠️ Fixes

- The **crash issue** occurring during gameplay has been resolved.  

- The **wood breaking mechanic** now works correctly.

🎨 Improvements

- Various **UI (User Interface)** bugs have been fixed.  

- The **lighting system** has been enhanced to create a more immersive atmosphere.

Your feedback is always valuable to us!  

Enjoy the game! 🌟
